author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Тест нового эмулятора PS2 для Android EmuCoreX на консоли RP G2
summary: A 20-minute Retroid Pocket G2 test that exposes a practical Vulkan rendering problem and demonstrates why per-game OpenGL comparison matters.

blocks.text: Yaranga Plus records EmuCoreX directly on a Retroid Pocket G2, inspects the video options, raises internal resolution and anisotropic filtering, hides the touch overlay, and launches several PS2 workloads. The most informative sequence shows incorrect image output under Vulkan in a God of War scene, followed by a quick switch to OpenGL that restores the expected picture.

Because the presenter changes settings while testing, the footage is valuable as troubleshooting evidence rather than a fixed benchmark. It shows that renderer choice can matter more than a blanket “best settings” preset on this handheld. Resolution, Texture Offset and other live changes also create artifacts later in the recording, so those results should be read together with the stated setting changes.
